minZoom.description:
The minimum zoom level.
This value can be from 0 to 18.
The default value is 0.

maxZoom.description:
The maximum zoom level.
The value can be from 1 to 18.
The default value is 18.

zoomGroupLevel.description:
Zoom level group, this value is used to group nodes/editors based on the zoom level.
The value can be from 0 to 3.
If the value is not defined, it will be calculated based on the zoom level.

title: Type to represent the abstract zoom configuration for graph visualization.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationMapZoomConfig
